issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby/Description — accessibility warning only, non-blocking
THREE.Clock deprecation warning and WebGL ReadPixels GPU stall perf warning — cosmetic, not functional

critical_code_review_comments: server.py @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') uses deprecated FastAPI event hooks; consider lifespan context manager.
DialogContent components in modals should include an accessible description (DialogDescription / aria-describedby) to silence Radix a11y warning.
HackerAvatar3D uses THREE.Clock which is deprecated in current three.js — switch to THREE.Timer (minor).
/api/vision/observe uses session_id='secu-vision' constant in LlmChat for every request; cross-visitor context is unlikely due to short prompt but using a per-request UUID would be cleaner.
seed_data_creation: Inserted TEST_Secu Visitor lead via API during run; visible on admin dashboard. Generated synthetic person & scenery JPEG fixtures for vision tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_secu_backend.py (pytest + requests). Vision tests use synthetic JPEG fixtures; the person fixture is simple geometric art — Gemini usually returns a safe clothing-color comment or NONE; both are accepted. Mic (Web Speech API) and getUserMedia are not available in headless; UI validated via text chat + Selfie-without-camera toast. Admin dashboard confirmed working with chart + leads table + CSV.
